title: Siren Drop 220 (instrumental)
style: Instrumental, no vocals, 220 BPM, aggressive hard trap / phonk, opens with a rising-pitch siren riser building tension, then a sudden hard drop into deep continuous distorted 808 bass shredding, rapid triplet 808 snare rolls and hi-hats on top, dark, relentless, high-energy, modern hard trap production
lyrics:
[Intro - instrumental, rising pitch siren riser, no drums, building tension]

[Drop - instrumental, sudden deep continuous 808 bass shred, triplet 808 snares on top]

[Breakdown - instrumental, siren returns over held bass]

[Drop - instrumental, deep 808 bass shred, rapid triplet snare rolls, full energy]

[Outro - instrumental, siren fades out]
